scope: German-first fully local realtime ASR challenger. Source evidence only; no clay-direct-dev hardware, model-runtime, German benchmark, E2E, Trigger-4 acceptance, or whole-system credit.

coordination_check.interpretation: No Speechcatcher-named F2 commit was found immediately before this write. This is a duplicate-risk check, not proof of complete semantic absence.

source_observations: The Speechcatcher project exposes local file and live-microphone transcription and states that it runs fast on CPUs without requiring a GPU.
The current CLI defaults to the German de_streaming_transformer_xl model and also exposes German m and l streaming variants.
The project includes a Vosk-compatible websocket server for live transcription and documents improved dynamic endpointing plus an experimental native decoder in later releases.
The project reports German TUDA-de-raw results without an LM of WER/CER 11.57/3.38 for m, 9.65/2.76 for l, and 8.5/2.44 for xl.

The project explicitly warns that TUDA-de-raw uses raw lowercased utterances without normalization, so those numbers are not directly comparable to regular TUDA-de results or Frankenstein corpus measurements.
The current XL Hugging Face model card is German, streaming-oriented, and reports MIT metadata plus 8.5% WER and 2.4% CER on TUDA-de-raw without an LM.

The XL model configuration uses a contextual_block_transformer with block_size 40, hop_size 16 and look_ahead 16. This establishes a source-level streaming architecture property, not target-host latency.
Speechcatcher project material states that its models were trained using Whisper large as a teacher.

license_provenance_warning.required_before_artifact_admission: Pin the exact downloadable artifact revision and license/provenance files together; do not infer artifact license solely from the current README metadata.

project_delta.reason: Speechcatcher is a useful falsifier for the assumption that a newer general multilingual ASR family must dominate a German-specialist streaming CPU path. It should be evaluated only on the same pinned German room/overlap/backchannel corpus and target host as Qwen3-ASR, Nemotron streaming and donor Whisper.
measurements: network-blocked/offline operation after a provenance-clean local cache is prepared

hypothesis: A German-specialized contextual-block streaming model can provide a materially cheaper CPU latency floor and useful endpoint behavior while retaining sufficient conversational German accuracy for Frankenstein 2.0.
counterhypothesis: The reported TUDA-de-raw accuracy may not transfer to noisy conversational German, overlap, room acoustics or barge-in, and modern multilingual Qwen3-ASR/Nemotron/Whisper paths may dominate once identical target-host conditions are measured.

current_runtime_gate.negative_boundary: A cancelled workflow with zero jobs is control-plane/runner evidence only. It is not a model, sandbox, hardware-capability or scientific negative result.
